In detail

Tuindorp Oostzaan is one of Amsterdam's 110 official wijken (CBS/gemeente boundaries). CBS (Statistics Netherlands) recorded 403 registered crimes here in 2025 across a population of 12,545 residents — a rate of 3,212 crimes per 100,000 residents, roughly 0.2× the citywide average, below it. This rate is calculated against registered residents, not footfall, so a busy shopping, transit or tourist area (like the city centre) can read higher without that meaning it is unusually risky to walk through, and a quiet residential wijk can show a low rate simply by having few offences relative to its population. This is Wandroz's official-data layer for Amsterdam — real CBS crime and population statistics, not a qualitative or press-based judgment — and the source data does not distinguish day from night, so both figures shown here are the same.
